name: How do I choose the right contractor for my garage finishing project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my garage finishing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience in garage transformations, positive client testimonials, and a valid license and insurance. Request detailed proposals, compare bids, and ensure clear communication regarding timelines, costs, and project scope. Ask for references and view past projects to assess their quality of work and reliability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, license, insurance, testimonials, detailed proposals, clear communication, and references.
